description: Retunes a volt per octave pitch: it reads the incoming voltage as a key of a piano keyboard and sends out the pitch that key has in the chosen tuning

inputs.text: Takes a volt per octave pitch with 0V as middle C, read as a whole piano key rather than followed continuously

outputs.text: The pitch of that key in the chosen tuning, in volts where one volt doubles the frequency; a scale octave is only exactly 1V in the tunings whose octave is a two to one ratio

notes: the keyboard drawn on the panel shows the names the black keys take under the chosen mapping, and the strip below it names the chosen tuning; no click on either reaches this help
the module does nothing on its own: it needs a pitch at the input and a VCO on the output, and it comes up in 12-TET, where the output matches the input
menu: Black key mapping: All flat (Gb), F# (default), C#, G#, D#, All sharp (A#) — chooses whether each black key is read as a flat or as a sharp, which outside 12-TET are different pitches
Tuning: 12-TET, Pythagorean, 1/4-comma Meantone, 1/3-comma Meantone, 5-limit (Cleantone), 7-limit (m3=7/6 P5=3/2), 19-TET, 31-TET — sets the two intervals every pitch is built from
